name: Picker dialog
author: Brett
description: Replaces every drop-down select box with the themed picker dialog (a bottom sheet on phones): search past a threshold, groups, icons, descriptions, multi-select with checkboxes. Drawn only with the --fx-picker-* tokens, so themes and skins restyle it. Turn it off and the original drop-downs come back untouched.

items.title: Pickers on the open screen
items.description: Every picker on the open console screen (id, address, label, value, chosen labels, options), which one is open, its search and active row, and the last action's answer.

items.skip: the open console reports its pickers here; not a command

items.title: Open a picker

target.description: the picker's id (data-fx-picker-id), button:picker-<id> or picker:<id>; omitted = the open picker

items.description: Opens a picker on the open console screen, as if its drop-down was tapped.

items.title: Choose an option in a picker
items.description: By value, else by spoken name or position ("the third one"). Single choice closes the picker.

target.description: the picker's id (data-fx-picker-id), button:picker-<id> or picker:<id>; omitted = the open picker

items.title: Toggle an option in a multiple-choice picker

target.description: the picker's id (data-fx-picker-id), button:picker-<id> or picker:<id>; omitted = the open picker

items.description: Ticks or unticks one option in a multiple-choice picker, by name or value.

items.title: Search in a picker

target.description: the picker's id (data-fx-picker-id), button:picker-<id> or picker:<id>; omitted = the open picker

items.description: Types into a picker's search box (opening it first) and returns the filtered rows.

items.title: Clear a picker's value

target.description: the picker's id (data-fx-picker-id), button:picker-<id> or picker:<id>; omitted = the open picker

items.description: Empties a picker's value (single: the empty choice; multiple: nothing ticked).

items.title: Close the picker

target.description: the picker's id (data-fx-picker-id), button:picker-<id> or picker:<id>; omitted = the open picker

items.description: Closes the open picker (or the one named) without choosing.

items.title: Refresh the list of pickers on the screen
items.description: Asks the open console to report every picker on its screen again.

items.title: Picker dialog settings
items.description: Reads the picker dialog settings: on/off, search threshold, phone sheet, what it replaces, excluded apps.

items.title: Change picker dialog settings
items.description: Changes any picker dialog setting; the console applies it at once.

items.title: Run a picker voice phrase
items.description: 'open the <field> picker', 'choose <option> [in the <field> picker]', 'pick the third one', 'search the <field> picker for <text>', 'close the picker'. AmberX reaches the same phrases through /api/console-control/voice.

items.skip: same handler as POST /open (the route runs this action)
